v1.47.6c (2 January 2025) |feed_title = New Years |feed_color = Green |previous_update = [[v1.46.0]] |next_update = [[v1.48.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.47.0''' is the one hundredth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 20th of December 2024. It added the [[Firework Technician]], brought in the [[Sledger]] rework and made many other changes. This update encompassed fourteen versions, the main v1.47.0 (released 20 December 2024) and thirteen minor updates, the v1.47.1 (released 21 December 2024), v1.47.1a (released 21 December 2024), v1.47.2 (released 21 December 2024), v1.47.3 (released 23 December 2024), v1.47.4 (released 25 December 2024), v1.47.5 (released 26 December 2024), v1.47.5a (released 28 December 2024), v1.47.5b (released 28 December 2024), v1.47.5c (released 31 December 2024), v1.47.6 (released 31 December 2024), v1.47.6a (released 31 December 2024), v1.47.6b (released 1 January 2025) and v1.47.6c (released 2 January 2025). ==Additions== ===Towers=== :In '''v1.47.5c''': *[[Firework Technician]] ===Enemies=== *[[Cold Mist (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Crying Angel (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Deep Freeze (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Frost Invader (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Frost Necromancer (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Frost Ravager (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Frozen (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Packed Ice (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Snowy (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Unstable Ice (Frost Invasion)]] *[[Snow Golem (Cold Ambush)]] *[[Snowman (Cold Ambush)]] ===Maps=== *[[Retro Lighthouse]] (Survival) *[[Simplicity|Simplicity Remaster]] (Survival) ===Stickers=== :In '''v1.47.4''': *[[Cookie Scout]] ===Miscellaneous=== *'''Nuclear Winter''' [[Mission Quests|Mission]] :In '''v1.47.4''': *New [[Codes|code]]: MERRY2024 **Gives one [[Holiday Crate]] and [[Cookie Scout]] sticker. :In '''v1.47.5c''': *'''Happy New Years!'''
